stem.text: The diagram shows a protein molecule.

stem.alt: Drawing of a protein molecule: a long fibre of wavy strands with a globular head at each end, with two short strands drawn on each head. A key beside it shows a solid line for long polypeptide and a dashed line for short polypeptide.

stem.text: Two long polypeptides each form $\alpha$-helices for much of their length and these twist together into a fibre.
At one end, each of these polypeptides coils into a globular head.
Two short polypeptides bind to each head.
What describes the protein structure of this molecule?

A.text: quaternary structure because each molecule consists of six polypeptides

B.text: secondary structure because the long polypeptides form $\alpha$-helices

C.text: tertiary structure because the $\alpha$-helices form a fibre

D.text: tertiary structure because the heads form globular proteins
